sloka: तेषां तु हतशेषा ये ते गत्वा लघुविक्रमाः ।निहतं च महत्सैन्यं रावणायाचचक्षिरे ।। ५.५८.११५ ।।।।
transliteration: teṣāṁ tu hataśeṣā ye te gatvā laghuvikramāḥ ।nihataṁ ca mahatsainyaṁ rāvaṇāyācacakṣire ।। 5.58.115 ।।।।

translations.english: "Those who were left behind, the less powerful ones went and reported to Ravana that the great army has been killed.
